================================================================================
C CODE COMPILED IN BY THE LIBMIMALLOC-SYS CRATE

The libmimalloc-sys crate (the `mimalloc` feature, on by default since 4.19.0)
compiles Microsoft's mimalloc allocator from the sources it bundles
(c_src/mimalloc/v3, its default) and links it statically into the vericto-proxy binary.
cargo-about only sees the crate's own license (MIT, Octavian Oncescu), so the
notice of the C library is kept here and appended by build-notices.sh.

Refresh this file when libmimalloc-sys changes version: the image build stops if
the version below does not match Cargo.lock.

libmimalloc-sys version: 0.1.49
